judgments.rationale: Affordability simulation at checkout is a known BNPL practice; business-method exposure.
SKU-level footprint from receipts is offered commercially (e.g. Doconomy/Cogo-style trackers).
Consent-chain certification (US12719671B1) and data-access consent patents are adjacent; signed deletion attestations in a transparency log are a moderately new combination.
Cross-chain burn/mint and atomic settlement patents and live products (CCTP) cover it.
Cognitive-decline detection from device interaction (Panasonic US20210186410A1; finger-interaction frameworks) plus elder-exploitation monitoring exists.
Digital-footprint-age synthetic ID detection is a commercial product category.
MPC/privacy-enhancing-tech fraud consortia are known and deployed.
Counterfactual adverse-action explanations are well documented.
